as_told.title: Princeton PEAR lab and SRI psi research

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says scientists at elite US universities studied random event generators, machines that produce random numbers, to test whether the human mind can influence them. In different episodes he points to the statistician Jessica Utts, to SRI (a California research institute), and to Princeton's Engineering Anomalies Research lab, which he says was started by Robert Jahn, dean of the engineering school there. If such effects were real, they would show the mind can affect the physical world directly.
